title: TestPhi — Test Execution Dashboard
description: Pre-built Grafana dashboard for TestPhi. Connect to your Supabase Postgres database with a read-only role.

panels.title: Pass Rate Trend (Last 30 Runs)
panels.query: SELECT started_at AS time, ROUND((passed::float / NULLIF(total_cases, 0)) * 100, 1) AS pass_rate FROM test_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 30;

panels.title: Tests Passed vs Failed (Last 30 Runs)
panels.query: SELECT started_at AS time, passed AS passed, failed AS failed, skipped AS skipped FROM test_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 30;

panels.title: Suite Execution Duration (Minutes)
panels.query: SELECT started_at AS time, (duration_sec::float / 60) AS duration_min, suite_type FROM test_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 30;

panels.title: Flaky Tests (Score > 20%)
panels.query: SELECT title, flaky_score, test_type, category, last_run_status FROM test_cases WHERE flaky_score > 20 ORDER BY flaky_score DESC;

panels.title: Requirements Coverage
panels.query: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN has_coverage THEN 1 END)::float / COUNT(*) * 100, 1) AS coverage_pct FROM requirements;

panels.title: Uncovered Requirements
panels.query: SELECT req_id, title, source, is_critical FROM requirements WHERE NOT has_coverage ORDER BY is_critical DESC, req_id;

panels.title: Defects by Severity
panels.query: SELECT severity, COUNT(*) AS count FROM defects WHERE status IN ('open', 'in_progress') GROUP BY severity ORDER BY severity;

panels.title: Defects by Status
panels.query: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM defects GROUP BY status ORDER BY status;

panels.title: Validation Score Distribution
panels.query: SELECT validation_score FROM test_cases WHERE validation_score > 0;

panels.title: CI/CD Run History
panels.query: SELECT timestamp, commit_sha, commit_message, triggered_suite, pass_rate, github_status FROM cicd_runs ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Tests per Suite
panels.query: SELECT s.name AS suite_name, COUNT(sm.test_case_id) AS test_count FROM test_suites s LEFT JOIN suite_memberships sm ON s.id = sm.suite_id GROUP BY s.name;

panels.title: Recent Test Runs
panels.query: SELECT started_at, suite_name, suite_type, environment, status, total_cases, passed, failed, skipped, duration_sec FROM test_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 20;
